descriptionText:
Akima Mission Optimization (AMO), an Akima company, is hiring a Junior Web Developer to support the Naval Air Warfare Center Training Systems Division. The role develops and maintains websites, web applications, and databases, with a focus on full-stack development, usability, performance, and integration.
Responsibilities
Develops, implements, and maintains websites, web applications, and application databases
Ensures all code is properly structured, adheres to industry standards, and is compatible with various browsers and devices
Optimizes website performance, scalability, and server-side code and processes
Integrates websites with other computer applications and develop website infrastructure
Designs user-friendly interfaces, navigation menus, and digital layouts that ensure compatibility and usability across different browsers and devices
Utilizes web frameworks and client-side coding to enhance user experience
Skills
Must be a US Citizen with a Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one prior to start)
B.S. degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering specializing in Web Design and Development
Experience in web development, with programming languages such as: React, JavaScript, Typescript, SQL, and CSS
Experience designing, developing, or integrating RESTful APIs and backend services
Working knowledge of SQL databases, including queries, schema design, and data integration
Familiarity with Git-based version control, including branching, merging, and code collaboration
Experience writing, updating, and maintaining efficient, testable, and well-documented code
Basic familiarity with Linux environments, command-line operations, or Bash scripting
Proven experience in writing, updating, and maintaining efficient, testable, and well-documented code
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills
Active Secret clearance
Experience with Python libraries or frameworks such as pandas, NumPy, Flask, FastAPI, Django, Plotly, Dash, or SQLAlchemy
Experience with React-based application development, including state management, reusable components, and responsive design
Familiarity with Docker, Docker Compose, or similar containerization tools
Experience with GitLab, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, or similar DevOps workflows
Familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS EC2, S3, or equivalent services
Experience managing or supporting web servers such as Nginx, Apache, or cloud-hosted application environments
Understanding of web application performance concepts such as lazy loading, optimized rendering, asset management, and computational efficiency
Experience working in an Agile development environment, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, and estimation using tools such as Jira
Benefits
Access to comprehensive benefits
Growth opportunities
Excellent retirement options
Company Overview
Akima focuses on delivering services in the areas of logistics, IT, supply chain, systems engineering, construction and protective services. It was founded in 1995, and is headquartered in Herndon, Virginia, USA, with a workforce of 5001-10000 employees. Its website is https://www.akima.com.
